reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Eli Dourado.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Eli Dourado, economist and senior research fellow at the Center for Growth and Opportunity at Utah State University. In our discussion, we touch on the ongoing stagnation in labor productivity, the system constraints, and some of the innovative technologies that could reverse this trend.

key_points.text: While Eli identifies as an economist, his wealth of knowledge on biotech innovation, alternative energy.
I hope you enjoy my conversation with Eli.
